title: Scattered Preprocessing Directives
pattern: Repetitive use of platform-specific conditional compilation attributes (such as `#[cfg]` in Rust or `#ifdef` in C/C++) directly inside functional logic blocks.
why_bad: Creates multiple disjoint compilation branches in a single file, destroying readability and hiding compilation errors on uncompiled tracks. It makes test coverage mapping impossible.
detection: Conditional preprocessor checks located inside function bodies rather than at file or module boundaries.
fix: Isolate platform-specific logic behind clear interfaces or traits; resolve the correct implementation at the compilation boundary (module-level) or linker stage.
source: [Robert C. Martin Series] Robert C. Martin - *Clean Architecture_ A Craftsman’s Guide to Software Structure and Design* (2017, Prentice Hall).pdf, Chapter 28; [Robert C. Martin series] Feathers, Michael C - *Working effectively with legacy code* (2013, Prentice Hall PTR).pdf, Chapter 21.
